newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield America says Lowy sell down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield America says Lowy sell down.

text.p: The manager of Westfield America Trust said on Wednesday, interests associated with the Lowy family had sold 84.95 million units of the trust to investment bank, SBC Warburg, for an undisclosed amount.

Following the sale the Lowy family will retain an 11 percent direct interest in the trust and an indirect stake through its 42.5 percent stake in Westfield Holdings Ltd which owns 49.1 percent of the trust.

"Westfield America Management Ltd has been advised that neither the Lowy family nor Westfield Holdings will make any further sales of their respective unitholdings in the Westfield America Trust over the next twelve months as these investments are regarded as being long-term an not for sale," the manager said in a statement.
Westfield America Trust units closed two cents higher at A$1.19.
